summary: The session provides a practical guide for measuring the cost, risk, and value of Generative AI (GenAI) initiatives, emphasizing the importance of selecting the right use cases and aligning them with business strategies. It discusses the challenges organizations face in demonstrating financial value from AI investments and introduces a structured approach to evaluate and prioritize AI projects. Key insights include the necessity of cross-functional collaboration and the use of a funding funnel to ensure effective resource allocation.

key_points: Importance of measuring financial value in AI investments
Challenges in demonstrating ROI for GenAI projects

sections.topic: Selecting Use Cases and Business Alignment
key_points: Need for careful selection of use cases to demonstrate value
Aligning AI initiatives with business strategy and risk appetite
Using a litmus test to evaluate project feasibility
Collaboration between business and technical teams for value assessment
Differentiating between monetary and non-monetary value
Identifying KPIs relevant to AI initiatives
Real-world examples of successful AI initiatives
Importance of transparency in project evaluations
Encouragement to apply structured frameworks for AI projects
Importance of ongoing collaboration and learning

key_takeaways: Select AI use cases that align with business strategies to ensure measurable value.
Utilize a structured funding funnel to prioritize and evaluate AI initiatives effectively.
Foster collaboration between business and technical teams to enhance the feasibility and value assessment of AI projects.
